## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Field boundaries for Slovenia - Eurocrops 2021](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_si) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for Slovenia

Provides ca. 800,000 official field boundaries of Slovenia for 2021. It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from the EuroCrops Shapefile that provides crop classification values that are harmonized across Europe. The data was provided to EuroCrops under an open license from the Slovenian government.

- **Source Data Provider:** [EuroCrops](https://github.com/maja601/EuroCrops/wiki/Slovenia)
- **Converted by:** [Daniel Nwaeze](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-nwaeze/)
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0
- **Projection:** Slovenia 1996 / Slovene National Grid

---

- **[Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/slovenia-ec/data/slovenia_eurocrops_2021_fiboa.parquet)**
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/slovenia-ec/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/slovenia-ec/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/slovenia-ec/data/slovenia_eurocrops_2021.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property        | Data Type   | Description                                                                 |
|-----------------|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| id            | string     | Numerical identifier                           |
| area          |   float    | Area in hectares                               |
| gerk_pid      |   uint64   | GERK polygon identification number             |
| crop_type_class | string  | Crop type classification                        |
| rastlina      |  string   | Crop type in slovenian language                 |
| crop_lat_e    | string   |   Crop type in latin or english language         |
| color         | string   | Color (hex), used for display by Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Food (MAFF)    |
| EC_trans_n    | string  | The original crop name translated into English  |
|   EC_hcat_n   | string | The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop        |
|   EC_hcat_c   | uint32 | The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop  |
|   EC_NUTS3   | string | The Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics 3 (NUTS3) region, an approximate assignment of a crop parcel to a region  |

## Lineage 

- Data downloaded on 2024-06-10 from https://zenodo.org/records/10118572/files/SI_2021.zip?download=1.
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.5.0-dev.
